# Embeddings


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

## `Embedding` class

> holds the concrete per‑subject feature×time matrices and minimal
> provenance needed for deterministic, composable analysis; every
> transformation in the pipeline - PCA, filtering, wavelets,
> reconstruction - both consumes and produces embeddings, making them
> the system’s universal interchange format.

## `EmbeddingCollection` class

> is a generalization of the more elementary `Embedding` class.

- It organizes multiple `Embedding` objects (of different types) and
  exposes a unified interface for cross‑embedding operations.

- It enables analyses that depend on comparing, correlating, or jointly
  inspecting several embeddings at once, providing the orchestration and
  dynamic dispatch that individual `Embedding` objects intentionally
  avoid.

- It can be created either

  - from a set of existing embeddings via the `EmbeddingCollection`
    constructor,

  - or directly from a single `Datasource` through `Datasource.project`
    method.

  The first approach allows embeddings originating from different
  `Datasource` objects to be combined, while the second is less flexible
  but syntactically more concise.
